# Fixer, R10-FLY-RELAY-REVIEW-FF (lane F, size S, instrument), topic r10-fly-relay-review-ff. Cut from current origin/main (4c31eb16 or later).

The orchestrator has promoted this group: it blocks the critical-path merge seat each time a relayed verdict goes unposted (4 instances in 2 days, #2659 and #2632 on 2026-10-23).

Priority order inside the group:
1. P-O, the confirm-retry arm. cloud_relay.sh ledgers a probe (cloud-relayed) before confirm runs, so a failed or skipped confirm is never retried ('already relayed'), and the confirm failure text goes to /dev/null. Add a confirm arm to `pass`: for each dispatched review/<pr> whose review commit is not in bus.sh's posted record, run `bus.sh confirm <pr> <sha>` (idempotent: post_verdict refuses 'already posted'). Print POSTED on success; after bounded retries, OWED stays on the level. Make no gh call. Log the last stderr line of a confirm failure in the OWED message. The orchestrator's relay log is not in the tree, so you cannot read it. Design the arm to cover all three causes: confirm failed, stale script, relayed by a non-confirm call.
2. The brief's items: the non-fast-forward review/<N> re-apply (never force; report the remote tip via ls-remote); tick_loop.sh relay_start passing --confirm; and probe_arm retrying transients instead of writing .refused on every non-zero rc, logging REFUSED <ref> <reason>.
Each item needs a failing fixture first and null controls: an already-posted review does nothing, an undispatched review logs OWED once. Mutants: drop the arm, drop the posted check. Each must go red. Keep hunks in cloud_relay.sh tight. ORCH-LEDGER (topic r10-orch-ledger, unmerged) and UPDATE-PR-SIGNALS also edit this file, and whichever lands later merges main.
Before returning, run `PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1 bash tools/pr/prepr.sh` until all ok at the final head. That includes the agreement lane and no ADDED UNPINNED mutation sites; pin with `python3 tests/mutation_table.py --pin-killed` and add a value check for each survivor. Update tools/audit/seat/INSTRUMENTS.md for any behaviour change.
